role.altitude: The small engine mechanic keeps diagnosing, repairing, showing customers how to care for machines and advising at the counter; paper job cards, adding up hours and parts, pricing estimates and paging through parts catalogues shrink.
skills_to_grow: Booking time and parts on the work order as the job goes
role.ambitious_version: A mechanic whose job is invoiced the moment the machine is ready, with every part and hour on it.

tasks.short: Record repairs made on the job card, record time spent and parts used, and have the job card typed into the shop system for invoicing.

steps.what: Small engine mechanic records repairs made on the job card
Small engine mechanic records time spent on the repair
Small engine mechanic records parts used
Counter staff type the job card into the shop system for the invoice

tasks.design: The job card becomes a work order on a workshop tablet. The mechanic picks repair codes and adds short notes, taps start and stop on the work order instead of noting times, and scans part barcodes from the shelf, which also lowers stock. The completed work order goes to invoicing without retyping. Time stamps are used for invoicing, not to rate the mechanic's speed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper job cards had to be added up and retyped at the counter.
tasks.enabler_now: Work order apps on tablets with barcode scanning, linked to invoicing.
tasks.still_hard: Jobs interrupted and resumed across days.
tasks.human_edge: Writing a note the next mechanic can use.

reach.learn: Whether invoices go out the same day.

evidence.claim: A field service tool covers work order to invoice, with post-calculation and invoicing in accounting.
In a two-month parallel run, a paper log had 52 errors and an electronic log 1.
If time stamps are used to watch technician speed, works council consent is needed first.

assumptions: Boundary: recording a repair; invoicing is outside.
Input contract for s3: barcode labels on stocked parts, about 80% of parts used; the rest are picked from a list.
Counter staff time is outside the mechanic's savings.
research_questions: Do missed parts on invoices fall?

incremental.description: Small engine mechanic corrects forgotten start or stop taps.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: long repairs with few parts; high: many short services with many parts.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Take the customer's booking, obtain problem descriptions from customers, inspect the machine, prepare cost estimates for repairs, check the estimate and send it to the customer.

steps.what: Customer describes the machine and problem in the online booking form
Small engine mechanic obtains problem descriptions from customers at the counter
Small engine mechanic inspects the machine to find the fault
Small engine mechanic prepares cost estimates for repairs: labour and parts
Small engine mechanic checks the final estimate
Small engine mechanic sends the approved estimate to the customer

approvals.approved_version: the estimate as checked by the mechanic in s5; any change needs a new check

tasks.design: Customers can book online with brand, model, symptom and a photo, so the counter talk starts from facts. Diagnosis stays with the mechanic. In the shop system the mechanic picks the repair, and standard repair times and the supplier price list fill labour and parts for the estimate. The mechanic checks it and sends it.
tasks.previous_blocker: Estimates were worked out from price lists and memory on paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Shop systems with standard repair times and supplier price lists.
tasks.still_hard: Faults that only show after the engine is opened.
tasks.human_edge: Telling a customer honestly when a repair is not worth it.
tasks.altitude: Less pricing by hand; diagnosis stays.

reach.learn: Whether online bookings with photos shorten counter talks.

evidence.claim: Repair bills from hours times rate and parts at list price are deterministic code.
A field service tool covers work order to invoice.

assumptions: Boundary: from the customer's problem to the estimate sent; the repair is outside.
Input contract for s4: standard repair times set by the shop owner and price lists loaded from suppliers; about 80% of repairs have a standard time; s4 is priced at that share.
Customers' effort on the booking form is about what a phone call took and sits in s1.
Diagnosis and sending keep their full time.
unknowns: Share of customers who book online.
research_questions: Do estimates match final bills more often?

incremental.description: Small engine mechanic keeps standard repair times current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: unusual machines with no standard times; high: routine services on common brands.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Show customers how to maintain equipment at handover, answer their follow-up questions and give them maintenance instructions for their model.

steps.what: Small engine mechanic shows customers how to maintain the equipment at handover
Small engine mechanic answers customers' follow-up questions by phone
Small engine mechanic writes maintenance instructions for the customer's model

tasks.design: The shop keeps one-page maintenance sheets per common model, taken from manufacturer manuals, printed with the work order and handed over at the demonstration. With the sheet in hand, customers call back less. Showing customers stays face to face.
tasks.previous_blocker: Instructions were explained verbally or written by hand each time.
tasks.enabler_now: Standard maintenance sheets printed from the shop system.
tasks.still_hard: Customers who do not read instructions.
tasks.human_edge: Showing someone with their own hands how to clean a carburettor.

reach.learn: Whether fewer machines come back for avoidable faults.

evidence.claim: Shop systems can print standard documents with a work order.

assumptions: Boundary: teaching customers to maintain their machines; repairs are outside.
Input contract for s3: maintenance sheets prepared once per common model from manufacturer manuals, covering about 70% of machines.
The demonstration keeps its full time.
unknowns: How many models the shop services.

incremental.description: Small engine mechanic writes maintenance sheets for new models.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly odd or old machines; high: mostly common current models.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Advise customers on parts and equipment, look up part numbers, sell parts and equipment at the till, and prepare, check and place orders for parts not in stock.

steps.what: Small engine mechanic advises customers on parts and equipment at the counter
Small engine mechanic looks up part numbers in manufacturer catalogues
Small engine mechanic sells parts and equipment at the till
Small engine mechanic prepares orders for parts not in stock
Small engine mechanic checks the final parts order
Small engine mechanic places the approved order with the supplier

approvals.approved_version: the parts order as checked by the mechanic in s5; any change needs a new check

tasks.design: The shop system links to suppliers' parts catalogues by model and serial number, showing part number, own stock and supplier stock in one search instead of paging through catalogues. Sales go through the till from the same search, and missing parts go onto an order the mechanic checks and places. Advice at the counter stays human.
tasks.previous_blocker: Part numbers were looked up in separate catalogues per brand.
tasks.enabler_now: Shop systems linked to supplier parts catalogues.
tasks.still_hard: Old machines no longer in any catalogue.
tasks.human_edge: Recommending the right machine for a customer's garden.

evidence.claim: Shop systems can link to supplier parts catalogues and stock.

assumptions: Boundary: counter sales and parts orders; deliveries are outside.
Input contract for s2: catalogues published electronically by the main suppliers, about 75% of the brands sold; others stay on paper or supplier sites; s2 is priced at that share.
Advice, checking and placing orders keep their full time.

incremental.description: Small engine mechanic reports catalogue errors to suppliers.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: mostly advice on new machines; high: many parts sales for common brands.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional
